crowndental.AI is a startup building tech for preventive healthcare, starting in the dental field. We're early-stage, fast-moving, and hands-on. If you like short paths to decisions, real impact, and working on electronics and embedded systems that matter, we'd love to meet you. 1 Senior Electronics Engineer (f/m/x) ¿ What you'll work on:

 * Oversee electronic hardware development, including necessary infrastructure

 * Manage the full hardware lifecycle from system architecture and PCB design to lab validation

 * Contribute to building products from scratch, moving from concept via functional prototype to mass product

 * Design schematics and create layouts optimized for performance, EMC, reliability, and DFM in collaboration with suppliers

 * Build rapid prototypes to mitigate risk and conduct full commissioning, characterization, and verification

 * Perform hands-on board bring-up and use lab equipment to troubleshoot complex signal or power issues

 * Ensure all developments comply with required standards/norms and manage verification/validation procedures

 * Collaborate with other departments on technical feasibility to define clear system interfaces and support product-market fit

 * Presenting trade-offs, test results, and risk assessments in reviews and stakeholder meetings

 * Act as the technical point of contact for key B2B customers and company partners

¿ What you bring:

 * Proficient in layout, stack-up definition, impedance control, length matching, and EMI/EMC optimization

 * Deep understanding of data acquisition architectures, clocking, synchronization, and FPGA/SoM interfacing

 * Experienced in power integrity and analog/digital design for complex systems

 * Fluent in drafting specifications, test plans, and leading design reviews

 * Proven ability to iterate quickly and take ownership within interdisciplinary environments

 * Proficient with PCB Schematic Design & Layout (Altium), testing and troubleshooting

 * English C1 required; German B2 is a plus

¿ Why join us?

 * You have the final say on the tools and architecture

 * Take full responsibility for technical outcomes in a fast-paced, initiative-driven environment

 * Located at Rennweg-easy to reach by public transport

 * Shape the engineering culture and team structure from the beginning

 * Represent our technology function in executive meetings, board discussions, and at public industry events

¿ Sounds like a fit?

We'd love to hear from you!

Send your CV, portfolio, or just a few words about what you've built to:

¿ jobs@crowndental.AI

We're willing to overpay depending on your experience and skills. Across our organization, our employees come to work and change the world. We take on the toughest challenges with precision and accuracy. We push for the next big semiconductor breakthrough. We lead the way in one of the most critical and fast-moving industries on the planet. And we do it together, with deep connections and limitless collaboration.

The impact we have on the world is made possible by focusing on our people. So we recognize and celebrate our teams achievements. REQ ID: 204402

WHAT YOU WILL DO

 * Designs, develops and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from the beginning to the end: product definition and planning through production, release and end of product line

 * Technical counseling of internal teams on product design and configuration to accommodate customer requirements

 * Serves as the central resource for Clean Tools with design, process, manufacturing, test, quality and marketing as the product(s) move to production and distribution

 * Leads internal meetings and workshops with the product ownership-team and keeps the management informed about the results

 * Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product's lifecycle including modifications, upgrades and maintenance of the product or product line

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 * Minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years and a Master's degree; or a PhD with 3 years experience; or equivalent experience in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, Electrical or Electronics Engineering

* Experience with helpdesk and customer support tools such as Gorgias, Magento, Intercom, FrontApp, or Live Chat software

jobs.description:
1 Master Thesis "Bi-Static Sensing of UAVs" - JOB ID: 269595  * Reliable detection and localisation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) is becoming increasingly important for future civilian and commercial applications. This master's thesis focuses on the development and experimental validation of antenna arrays for bi-static sensing of UAVs using software-defined radio technology.
 * Under the guidance of our team, you will design, build, and characterise circularly polarised patch antennas for different array geometries for UAV sensing applications.
 * You will integrate the antenna arrays into an SDR-based testbed and perform experimental validation.
 * You will support us in developing simulation models for bi-static multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) sensing and realise a real-time measurement setup that can estimate azimuth, elevation and range.

 * You will gain hands-on experience with antenna design, beamforming, direction-of-arrival estimation, and software-defined radio systems.
 * You will learn how to validate the sensing algorithms using a state-of-the-art motion capture system.
 * You will work closely with researchers in wireless sensing and contribute to the development of next-generation UAV detection and localisation technologies.

Your qualifications:

 * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field.
 * First experience (e.g. gained through university / student research projects, laboratory work, internships or similar activities) in at least one of the following areas: (i) Antenna array design and validation measurements or (ii) micro-Doppler-based bi-static sensing methods. In the cover letter, the candidate shall describe how their CV and personal interests for future development match at least one of the above profiles (explicitly referring to (i) or (ii)) and substantiate their claimed expertise. Please note that applications that do not address this point may not be considered further.
 * You have a basic understanding of antennas, electromagnetics, and wireless communications.
 * Experience with RF measurement equipment, software-defined radio (SDR), or antenna simulation tools (e.g., CST, HFSS, or FEKO) is advantageous.
 * Programming experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ for signal processing, beamforming, or bi-static sensing applications is beneficial.
 * You enjoy developing hardware prototypes and numerical algorithms, as well as performing experimental validation.
 * English language skills commensurate with the role

What to expect:

 * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
 * Start date: ideally 01.10.2026 - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date
 * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week.
 * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
 * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).

 

 

At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.

 

Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.
